description: Root entry scripts must have --verbose and --debug flags
check: for f in mc.py admin.py tui.py; do rg -q "debug" "$f" && rg -q "verbose" "$f" || echo "MISSING: $f"; done
fix: Add --debug (logging.DEBUG) and --verbose (logging.INFO) options to all entry scripts

description: Python files must not exceed 1000 lines (target ~500)
check: find modules/ -name '*.py' -exec sh -c 'lines=$(wc -l < "$1"); if [ "$lines" -gt 1000 ]; then echo "$1: $lines lines"; fi' _ {} \;
fix: Split into focused submodules. Target ~400-500 lines average, hard limit 1000. Three legacy god modules are temporarily waived to warning severity pending decomposition — see FILE_SIZE_WAIVERS in scripts/code_rules_fast.py; do not add entries.
Catch specific exceptions: except Exception as e: with logging

description: No hardcoded host/port/URL values in module code
fix: Move to config/settings/*.yaml or config/.env. startup_checks.py validates config values, not hardcodes.

description: No hardcoded timeouts, batch sizes, or thresholds — use config
fix: Move hardcoded values to config/settings/*.yaml and read via get_app_config()

description: No TODO/FIXME/HACK/XXX markers in production code
fix: Implement the functionality, create a plan doc, or remove the stub

description: No datetime.now() or datetime.utcnow() — use utc_now() from core.utils
check: rg "datetime\.(now|utcnow)\(" modules/ --type py | rg -v "(compliance\.py|tools/codemap\.py|agents/vertical/|temporal/workflow\.py)" | rg -v "(docstring|Scan for|# )"
fix: Replace with: from modules.backend.core.utils import utc_now. Compliance scanners reference these patterns in docstrings — not violations.

description: No ad-hoc datetime construction — use utc_now() (returns timezone-aware UTC; DB columns are timestamptz per Plan 64)
fix: Replace with utc_now() from modules.backend.core.utils — the single source of current time. Convert external timestamps to aware UTC at the boundary.

description: No untyped **kwargs in public functions — use explicit params, TypedDict, or dataclasses
scope: modules/backend/ (excluding TUI widgets, logging, middleware, base repos, event factories)
fix: Replace **kwargs with explicit typed parameters. Exceptions: Click CLIs, decorator wrappers, Textual widget forwarding, generic base repository create/update, event factories, PydanticAI forwarding.
